title: 第1章 破屋里的三兄妹第2章 民俗之核
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
“呜呜呜……”
哪里来的哭声？
这么刺耳。
沈易的意识才开始悠悠转醒，猛然感受到一股剧烈的痛苦袭遍全身。
痛得他整个身体忍不住蜷缩了起来，死死咬住牙关。
嘶——
太痛了！
沈易勉强睁开眼睛，映入眼帘的却是一间破旧的小木屋。
屋内除了他之外，竟然还有着两个孩子。
他们看上去年龄都不大。
男孩大约十四五岁的年龄，女孩则是八九岁的样子……
沈易强自忍受着头部剧烈的痛楚，快速扫视着整间屋子的布局。
好歹作为一位久经杀戮场的资深猪肉佬，意志还算是比较坚韧。
虽然不知道自己是怎么会突然来到这个地方的。
但是显然，现在最明智的做法不是大喊大叫，而是迅速了解自己的处境。
才好想办法逃脱出困境。
不过在下一秒，沈易表情不由一滞。
他目光落在那两个孩子的脸上。
发现两个孩子虽然看到他醒过来之后表情无比激动，但是却还是用双手死死的捂住嘴巴，尽最大努力不让自己发出一点声音来。

既然这间屋子里面的三个人都没发出声音。
那是谁在哭？
沈易天灵盖陡然一紧，只觉头皮发麻，一阵冷意从脚底升起蔓延全身。
他迅速转头过去，视线扫向了哭声传来的方向。
在虚掩的木门处。
一只不断颤动的眼睛正在透过门缝疯狂往里面看。
眼白占了绝大部分，瞳孔则是如同针孔一般大小。
这东西……绝对不是人！
沈易心头剧震。
地球上所有的生物，都不可能会有这种给人带来强烈诡异感的眼睛！
伴随着诡异窥视而来，沈易下意识地屏住了呼吸，紧紧地警惕着木门方向。
嘭嘭嘭嘭嘭！
紧接着，木门突然响起剧烈的拍击声，整个门框都被拍得震颤不已。
是外面那个‘东西’在拍门……不，看这架势，它是在撞门！
撞击的动静变得越来越大。
沈易都担心木门会在下一秒化作木屑四散，让外面那头东西破门而入。
不过奇怪的是，这看上去无比脆弱的木门，居然硬是挺住了一阵阵凶猛的撞击。
直到半个小时之后，撞击声才不甘地停歇下去。
屋子里面恢复了平静。
这个时候，沈易看到那两个孩子站起了身子，朝着自己这边走来。

年纪稍大的男孩小心翼翼开口道：“大哥，天亮了，独目鬼应该退走了，你…没事吧？”
年纪稍小的女娃则是直接钻入沈易的怀里，双手紧紧抱住他，声音带着一丝哽咽，闷闷地从怀中传来：
“大哥，我好怕，我好怕你也跟爹娘不在我们身边了。”
沈易浑身剧痛之余，尚且感到一头雾水。

"Woooooooo..."
Where did the crying come from?
So harsh.
Shen Yi's consciousness slowly began to wake up, and he suddenly felt a sharp pain rushing through his body.
His whole body couldn't help but curl up in pain, and he gritted his teeth.
Hiss——
It hurts so much!
Shen Yi reluctantly opened his eyes, and what he saw was a dilapidated cabin.
Besides him, there were actually two children in the house.
They all look young.
The boy is about fourteen or fifteen years old, and the girl is eight or nine years old...
Shen Yi forced himself to endure the severe pain in his head and quickly scanned the layout of the entire room.
Anyway, as a veteran pork guy who has been through the killing fields for a long time, his will is relatively strong.
Although I don’t know how I came to this place suddenly.
But obviously, the wisest thing to do now is not to yell, but to quickly understand your situation.
Only then can we find a way to escape from the predicament.
But in the next second, Shen Yi's expression couldn't help but froze.
His eyes fell on the faces of the two children.
I found that although the two children were extremely excited after seeing him wake up, they still covered their mouths with their hands and tried their best not to make any sound.
Since none of the three people in this room made a sound.
Who is crying?
Shen Yitian's spiritual cap suddenly tightened, and he felt his scalp numb, and a chill rose from the soles of his feet and spread throughout his body.
He quickly turned his head and glanced in the direction where the crying came from.
At the ajar wooden door.
A trembling eye was looking frantically through the crack in the door.
The whites of the eyes take up most of it, and the pupils are as big as pinholes.
This thing... is definitely not human!
Shen Yi was shocked.
It is impossible for any creature on the earth to have such eyes that give people a strong sense of weirdness!
Accompanied by the strange peek, Shen Yi subconsciously held his breath and watched the direction of the wooden door closely.
Bang bang bang bang bang!
Immediately afterwards, there was a sudden violent banging sound on the wooden door, and the entire door frame was shaken by the banging sound.
It's that 'thing' outside that's knocking on the door... No, look at this posture, it's hitting the door!
The noise of the impact became louder and louder.
Shen Yi was worried that the wooden door would turn into sawdust and scatter in the next second, allowing the thing outside to break in.
But the strange thing is that this seemingly extremely fragile wooden door actually withstood a series of fierce impacts.
It wasn't until half an hour later that the banging stopped reluctantly.
Calm returned to the house.
At this time, Shen Yi saw the two children standing up and walking towards him.
The older boy said cautiously: "Brother, it's dawn and the one-eyed ghost should have retreated. Are you... okay?"
The younger girl got directly into Shen Yi's arms and hugged him tightly with both hands. Her voice was choked and came from her arms muffledly:
"Brother, I'm so scared. I'm so scared that you and your parents are no longer with us."
Shen Yi was in severe pain all over his body and felt confused.
